title: If I Could Only Be a Red Tractor
skill: CVC Short o, u, e (All 5 short vowels)
skill_description: Practice reading CVC words with all five short vowels, with 'tractor' and 'airplane' as high-interest heart words.
author: Tiia Vahula
summary: A blonde girl named Tiia daydreams about being a red tractor digging in mud and an airplane soaring through the sky. A story about imagination and the magic of pretend play, set in rural Estonia.

characters.tiia: Tiia, a small blonde girl (age 5-6) with wispy light blonde hair, wearing blue denim overalls over a cream-colored shirt

setting_context: Rural Estonia: traditional wooden farmhouses with steep shingled roofs, golden barley fields, birch forests in the distance, old red tractors common in the countryside

pages.text: If I Could Only Be a Red Tractor
pages.scene: Tiia, a small blonde girl (5-6) with wispy hair in blue overalls, sits in a golden barley field. Her eyes are closed, peaceful smile. Above her head, a thought bubble shows a bright red tractor and a small airplane. A traditional Estonian wooden farmhouse with steep roof visible in background. Late afternoon golden sunlight. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text:
Tiia sits in the hot sun.
A red tractor digs in the mud.
pages.scene: Tiia, a small blonde girl (5-6) with wispy hair in blue overalls, sits cross-legged in tall golden barley. Bright summer sun overhead. In the field behind her, an old red tractor with large wheels digs through dark brown muddy soil. Estonian countryside with birch trees at the edge of the field. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text:
"If I could only be a red tractor!"
Tiia shuts her eyes.
pages.scene: Close-up of Tiia, a small blonde girl (5-6) with wispy hair in blue overalls. Her eyes are squeezed shut, a big hopeful smile on her face. Golden sunlight glows on her hair. The red tractor is visible but blurred in the background field. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text:
RUM, RUM, RUM!
She tugs a big log.
pages.scene: Fantasy scene: A cheerful bright red tractor with Tiia's smiling blonde face visible in the cab window. The tractor strains to pull a massive fallen log through dark muddy earth. Effort and determination on her face. Motion lines show the tractor working hard. Estonian forest edge in background. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text:
She is strong! She is loud!
Mud on her legs. Mud on her belly.
pages.scene: Fantasy scene: The red tractor with Tiia's joyful face in the cab window, splashing through a deep brown mud puddle. Mud sprays everywhere - on the tractor's wheels, body, and all around. Pure joy on her face. Golden field and birch trees in background. Dynamic action. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text:
She does not quit.
A hum comes from up, up, up.
An airplane zips by!
pages.scene: Fantasy scene: The red tractor with Tiia's face in the cab window, stopped in the muddy field, looking upward at the sky. A small white airplane with a single propeller flies overhead, leaving a faint white trail against the blue sky. Her expression shows wonder and longing. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text:
"If I could only be an airplane!"
Tiia grins. ZIP! She is UP!
pages.scene: Fantasy transformation: A small white propeller airplane lifting off from a golden field, with Tiia's grinning blonde face visible through the cockpit window. The airplane is angled upward, climbing into a bright blue sky. Motion blur on the ground below shows speed. Joyful expression. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text:
She tips left. She dips right.
The sun is close. The hills are small.
pages.scene: Fantasy scene: A small white airplane with Tiia's delighted face in the cockpit, banking over Estonian countryside far below. Patchwork of tiny golden fields, dark green birch forests, and a winding blue river. The sun is large and golden nearby. Bird's-eye view showing the small world beneath her. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text:
She is fast. She is free.
"Tiia! Dinner!"
pages.scene: Fantasy scene: The small white airplane with Tiia's peaceful, free expression, soaring through fluffy white clouds. Golden sunset light. Far below, barely visible, a tiny Estonian farmhouse. A small speech bubble rises from below with the dinner call. The real world intruding on the daydream. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text:
Her eyes pop open.
She runs in.
pages.scene: Back to reality: Tiia, a small blonde girl (5-6) in blue overalls, jumping up from the golden barley field with surprised wide eyes. She runs toward a traditional Estonian wooden farmhouse with a steep shingled roof. Warm evening golden-hour light. Dust kicks up behind her feet. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text:
But part of her?
Still up in the clouds.
pages.scene: Tiia, a small blonde girl (5-6) in blue overalls, sits at a simple wooden dinner table inside a cozy Estonian farmhouse. She gazes dreamily out the window at the evening sky where the first stars appear. A small toy red tractor and a toy airplane sit on the table beside her plate. Warm lamplight inside, blue twilight outside. Wistful, peaceful expression. Warm watercolor style.

Tiia, a small blonde girl (5-6) in blue overalls, asleep in a cozy bed. Through the window, stars twinkle in the night sky. On her nightstand, the toy red tractor and toy airplane. A peaceful smile on her sleeping face, still dreaming. Warm watercolor style.

reference_prompt:
9-PANEL STYLE REFERENCE SHEET for children's book illustration

FOCUS: Character design, setting elements, and color palette. NOT story scenes.
IMPORTANT: Character in CENTER PANEL for maximum style influence.

Row 1 - OBJECTS AND CHARACTER INTRO:
[1] Red tractor: Old-style bright red farm tractor with large black wheels, friendly rounded shape, slightly worn and well-used look
[2] Tiia expressions: Small blonde girl (5-6) showing three small face portraits - eyes closed peaceful smile, wide-eyed wonder, joyful laughing
[3] Small airplane: White single-propeller airplane in corner, simple friendly design, small size

Row 2 - CHARACTER FOCUS (center):
[4] Tiia standing: Small blonde girl (5-6), wispy light blonde hair, blue denim overalls over cream shirt, friendly round face, standing in golden grass
[5] TIIA FULL FIGURE (CENTER): Same blonde girl in blue overalls, running joyfully through golden barley field, hair flowing, biggest and most detailed panel
[6] Tiia dreaming: Same girl sitting with eyes closed, peaceful smile, hands in lap, soft afternoon light on her face

Row 3 - ESTONIAN SETTING:
[7] Farmhouse: Traditional Estonian wooden farmhouse with steep shingled roof, weathered gray-brown wood, surrounded by golden barley
[8] Countryside: Estonian rural landscape - golden barley fields, birch forest with white trunks, blue sky
[9] Cozy interior: Simple farmhouse interior - wooden table, warm lamplight, window showing twilight sky

STYLE: Warm soft watercolor illustration. Muted earthy palette: sage green, terracotta, warm cream, soft gold, dusty blue. Soft painterly edges, no hard outlines. Gentle natural lighting. Friendly rounded shapes.

CRITICAL: NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS anywhere. Pure visual reference only.

parent_tips.before_reading: Preview the cover together. Ask: What do you think this girl is dreaming about? Have you ever pretended to be something else? Look for our special 'heart words': tractor and airplane.
parent_tips.during_reading: Help your child with 'tractor' and 'airplane' - these are special words we learn as wholes. Sound out the CVC words like: hot, sun, mud, big, log, zip, dip, tip, run, pop.
parent_tips.after_reading: Discuss: What did Tiia imagine being? Why do you think she wanted to be a tractor? An airplane? What would YOU want to be if you could be anything?

comprehension_questions.question: What is Tiia doing at the beginning?
comprehension_questions.answer: Sitting in the hot sun, watching a tractor

comprehension_questions.question: What two things does Tiia imagine being?
comprehension_questions.answer: A red tractor and an airplane

comprehension_questions.question: What does the tractor do in Tiia's imagination?
comprehension_questions.answer: Tugs a big log and splashes in mud

comprehension_questions.question: What does the airplane do?
comprehension_questions.answer: Tips left, dips right, flies fast and free
